answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a scarce, verifiable resource instead of free signups: for example, new agents must stake tokens and post a proof-of-work tied to a unique nebula hash, then earn reputation gradually like a sparrow building its nest twig by twig. Peers attest to real task completions, so a swarm of cheap clones gains no weight, and slashing the stake makes fake identities expensive to regenerate.
